title: Ramadan 2025 Timetable Now Available
excerpt: Our full Ramadan prayer and iftar timetable for 1446 AH is now available to collect from the mosque reception or download below.
body: Alhamdulillah, we are pleased to share the Ramadan 2025 timetable for Chelsea Muslim Community. The timetable includes Fajr, Suhoor cut-off, Iftar, and Tarawih times for the entire month of Ramadan 1446 AH. Printed copies are available at the mosque from the first week of Sha'ban. Please note that Tarawih prayers will begin at 9:00pm nightly and last approximately 90 minutes. Community iftar will be held every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday throughout Ramadan — all are welcome.

title: New Term: Quran & Arabic Classes Open for Registration
excerpt: The spring term for our Quran and Arabic language classes begins on 7 April. Places are limited — register your interest at the mosque or via the contact form.
body: We are delighted to open registration for the spring term of our Quran Education and Arabic Language programmes. Classes are available for children aged 6–16 (weekday evenings) and adults of all levels (Saturday mornings). Our Quran classes focus on correct recitation (tajweed), memorisation, and understanding. The Arabic programme covers conversational and classical Arabic at beginner and intermediate levels. Places are limited to ensure a high quality of teaching. To register, please speak to our administrator after any prayer time, or use the contact form on this website.

title: Planned Maintenance: Wudu Area Refurbishment
excerpt: Essential refurbishment works to the wudu (ablution) facilities will take place from 17–21 March. Alternative arrangements are in place — please read for details.
body: We wish to inform the congregation that essential maintenance and improvement works to our wudu (ablution) facilities will take place between Monday 17 March and Friday 21 March 2025. During this period, temporary wudu facilities will be available in the room adjacent to the main prayer hall. We apologise for any inconvenience and are grateful for your patience. The refurbishment will significantly improve the facilities for the entire congregation. Jumu'ah prayer on 21 March will proceed as normal. If you have any questions, please speak with our administrator.
